arxiv-2104-03534.title: On the size distribution of spots within sunspot groups
arxiv-2104-03534.creator: Sudip Mandal, Natalie A. Krivova, Robert Cameron, Sami K. Solanki
arxiv-2104-03534.description: Abstract Size distribution of sunspots provides key information about the generation and emergence processes of the solar magnetic field. Previous studies on the size distribution have primarily focused on either the whole group or individual spot areas. In this paper, we investigate the organization of spot areas within sunspot groups.

arxiv-2104-05262.title: The Theory of Universal Graphs for Infinite Duration Games
arxiv-2104-05262.creator: Thomas Colcombet ORCID:0000-0001-6529-6963 \rsuper a, Nathanaël Fijalkow ORCID:0000-0002-6576-4680 \rsuper b, Paweł Gawrychowski ORCID:0000-0002-6993-5440 \rsuper c, Pierre Ohlmann ORCID:0000-0002-4685-5253 \rsuper d
arxiv-2104-05262.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Thomas Colcombet ORCID:0000-0001-6529-6963 \rsuper a, Nathanaël Fijalkow ORCID:0000-0002-6576-4680 \rsuper b, Paweł Gawrychowski ORCID:0000-0002-6993-5440 \rsuper c, Pierre Ohlmann ORCID:0000-0002-4685-5253 \rsuper d. We introduce the notion of universal graphs as a tool for constructing algorithms solving games of infinite duration such as parity games and mean payoff games. In the first part we develop the theory of universal graphs, with two goals: showing an equivalence and normalisation result between different recently introduced related models, and constructing generic value iteration algorithms for any positionally determined objective.

arxiv-2412-20168.title: Nonlinear Conjugate Gradient Methods for Optimization of Set-Valued Mappings of Finite Cardinality
arxiv-2412-20168.creator: Debdas Ghosh, Ravi Raushan, Zai-Yun Peng, Jen-Chih Yao
arxiv-2412-20168.description: Abstract This article presents nonlinear conjugate gradient methods for finding local weakly minimal points of set-valued optimization problems under a lower set less ordering relation. The set-valued objective function of the optimization problem under consideration is defined by finitely many continuously differentiable vector-valued functions.

arxiv-2501-07441.title: An efficient preconditioner for mixed-dimensional contact poromechanics based on the fixed stress splitting scheme
arxiv-2501-07441.creator: Yury Zabegaev, Inga Berre, Eirik Keilegavlen, Kundan Kumar
arxiv-2501-07441.description: Abstract Numerical simulation of fracture contact poromechanics is essential for various applications, including CO 2 sequestration, geothermal energy production and underground gas storage. Modeling this problem accurately presents significant challenges due to the complex physics involved in strongly coupled poromechanics and frictional contact mechanics of fractures.

arxiv-2506-21936.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by . n − n- cycle permutation polynomials with small n have the advantage that their compositional inverses are efficient in terms of implementation. These permutation polynomials have significant applications in cryptography and coding theory. In this article, we propose criteria for the construction of n − n- cycle permutation using linearized polynomial L ⁡ ( x ) L(x) for larger n n . Furthermore, we investigate and generalize certain novel forms of n − n- cycle permutation polynomials.

pmc-10602350.title: Exploring the mechanisms underlying stroke volume variability reduction in a murine model of heart failure with reduced ejection fraction
pmc-10602350.creator: Gemma Fernández-Mendoza, Abraham Méndez-Fernández, Hugo J. Alves-Figueiredo, Gerardo García-Rivas, Moisés Santillán
pmc-10602350.description: Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF) is accompanied by disregulation of cardiovascular function. Heart rate variability (HRV) is commonly used to assess autonomic dysfunction in HFrEF. However, analysis of stroke volume variability (SVV) may provide additional insights. We examined HRV and SVV in a mouse model of HFrEF.

pmc-10609236.title: Facile Synthesis of Cu-Doped ZnO Nanoparticles for the Enhanced Photocatalytic Disinfection of Bacteria and Fungi
pmc-10609236.creator: Ruichun Nan, Shurui Liu, Mengwan Zhai, Mengzhen Zhu, Xiaodong Sun, Yisong Chen, Qiangqiang Pang, Jingtao Zhang, Yanxin Chen
pmc-10609236.description: In this study, Cu-doped ZnO was prepared via the facile one-pot solvothermal approach. The structure and composition of the synthesized samples were characterized by XRD (X-ray diffraction), TEM (transmission electron microscopy), and XPS (X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy) analyses, revealing that the synthesized samples consisted of Cu-doped ZnO nanoparticles.

pmc-10660512.title: Prolonged COVID-19 Infection in a Patient with Complete Remission from Follicular Lymphoma with Hyperosmolar Hyperglycemic Syndrome
pmc-10660512.creator: Takuya Omura, Akira Katsumi, Shuji Kawashima, Masahiro Naya, Haruhiko Tokuda
pmc-10660512.description: An 81-year-old woman undergoing B-cell depletion therapy developed COVID-19 and a hyperglycemic hyperosmotic state. She had a history of multiple vaccinations against coronaviruses but had persistent antigen positivity. Strategies to prevent the development of COVID-19 in immunosuppressed patients have not been established. Moreover, there is no standard treatment for prolonged antigen positivity.

pmc-11459094.title: Topological indices based VIKOR assisted multi-criteria decision technique for lung disorders
pmc-11459094.creator: Tahreem Ashraf, Nazeran Idrees
pmc-11459094.description: Lung disorders involve swelling, inflammation, and muscle tightening around the airways, with symptoms such as coughing, wheezing, shortness of breath, and abnormal fluid build-up. The global prevalence of these conditions is rising, highlighting the need for extensive research to alleviate their severity and symptoms.

pmc-12312732.title: Identification of the molecular subtype and prognostic characteristics of lung adenocarcinoma based on CD8+ T cell-related gene signature
pmc-12312732.creator: Keke Tang, Ji Shen, Dan Liu, Jia Che, Qifen Mao, Yixuan Zhou, Hainan Ye
pmc-12312732.description: BackgroundLung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) stands as a major respiratory malignancy with high mortality. With the advent of immunotherapy, new therapeutic avenues have emerged in cancer treatment.ObjectiveOur focus aimed at developing a CD8+ T cell-based immune gene prognostic model (CDIGPM) for LUAD, shedding light on the immunological aspects and the potential advantages of immunotherapy in distinct CDIGPM-defined LUAD categories.

pmc-12398011.title: Uptake of cervical cancer screening and its associated factors in Africa: an umbrella review of systematic reviews and meta-analyses
pmc-12398011.creator: Tadele Emagneneh, Chalie Mulugeta, Betelhem Ejigu, Abebaw Alamrew, Nigusie Abebaw, Adem Yessuf, Wagaw Abebe, Sefineh Fenta Feleke, Delelegn Tsegaye, Aynalem Yetwale Hiwot, Mulat Ayele, Amanuel Tebabal Nega
pmc-12398011.description: BackgroundCervical cancer poses a major public health burden in low- and middle-income countries, especially in Africa, despite being largely preventable through HPV vaccination and screening. This umbrella review synthesizes findings from systematic reviews and meta-analyses to identify factors influencing screening uptake, offering evidence to guide targeted interventions and policy responses across the continent.

pmc-12549165.title: Real-World Safety and Effectiveness of Ganirelix for Ovarian Stimulation in Chinese Women: A Multicenter, Prospective, Single-Arm, Observational Study
pmc-12549165.creator: Jia Li, Fei Gong, Lihong Geng, Xiaohong Wang, Zhaolian Wei, Jianqiao Liu, Yong Zeng, Jue Wang, Keith Gordon, Sisi Chen, Rui Yang, Rong Li
pmc-12549165.description: Background:This study aimed to evaluate the safety and effectiveness of ganirelix acetate for Chinese women undergoing ovarian stimulation (OS) in real-world clinical practice.Methods:This multicenter (16), prospective, single-arm, observational, post-authorization safety study included 1025 Chinese women receiving at least one dose of ganirelix during OS. Safety endpoints were collected until 5 weeks after embryo transfer.

pmc-12605634.title: The Psyche Light Elements Investigation
pmc-12605634.creator: Thomas H Prettyman, David W Mittlefehldt, Erik I Asphaug, Richard P Binzel, Samuel W Courville, Linda T Elkins-Tanton, David J Lawrence, Simone Marchi, José M G Merayo, Timothy J McCoy, Benjamin P Weiss
pmc-12605634.description: Light elements, such as C, S, Si, O, C, and H, are thought to be present in Earth’s liquid-Fe outer core. These elements lower melting temperatures, thereby allowing the core to remain in liquid state at high pressure and influencing magnetic and geodynamic processes.

pmc-12615774.title: Boosting the brightness of aggregation-caused quenching chromophore-based covalent organic frameworks via energy level matching strategy
pmc-12615774.creator: Liang Zhang, Weihang Geng, Xinwen Ou, Shan He, Xiao-Hang He, Wenlang Li, Yantian Jiao, Ziyi Cheng, Ziyi Jin, Jun Qian, Ben Zhong Tang
pmc-12615774.description: Most chromophores exhibit an aggregation-caused quenching (ACQ) effect, resulting in minimal or weak emission when incorporated into covalent organic frameworks (COFs). Consequently, the development of luminescent COFs, particularly those utilizing ACQ chromophores, presents both a compelling and formidable challenge. Herein, we report the construction of highly emissive ACQ chromophore-based COFs by an energy level matching strategy.

pmc-13569449.title: Intrinsic plasmon canalization in the biaxial van der Waals crystal MoOCl2
pmc-13569449.creator: Farid Aghashirinov, Andrea Mancini, Lin Nan, Giacomo Venturi, Bettina Frank, Harald Giessen, Antonio Ambrosio
pmc-13569449.description: Anisotropic polaritons in low-symmetry crystals allow for subwavelength confinement and directional routing of light. The most extreme form of such anisotropy arises at the topological transition between elliptical and hyperbolic dispersion, where the isofrequency contours collapse into parallel lines and polaritons propagate in a diffractionless, beam-like fashion. This canalization regime has previously been accessed through twisted heterostructures or engineered metasurfaces.
